title: Zero-transform web page intelligence for AI agents. Extracts OpenGraph + Twitter
description: Zero-transform web page intelligence for AI agents. Extracts OpenGraph + Twitter Card + Article metadata + JSON-LD structured data. Generates AI analysis via Claude Haiku tool_use: summary (one_line/three_lines/key_points), entities (orgs/people/products/locations/money/dates), classification (sentiment, credibility, content_type, bias_indicators, is_opinion, is_sponsored). Returns 16+ boolean signals for programmatic decisions. One call replaces 7 agent steps.
